mapper.select: SELECT resource_id, release_version, locale, messages_json::text AS messages_json, message_count, fallback_count, checksum, source_release_version, change_note, published_by, published_at FROM system_i18n_release WHERE resource_id = #{resourceId} AND release_version = #{releaseVersion} ORDER BY locale

SELECT release_version, max(source_release_version) AS source_release_version, max(change_note) AS change_note, max(published_by) AS published_by, max(published_at) AS published_at, count(*) AS locale_count FROM system_i18n_release WHERE resource_id = #{resourceId} GROUP BY release_version ORDER BY release_version DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
